title: User Signup via Email/Password
description: Verify that a new user can sign up using valid email and password, and receive an email verification link.

steps.description: Navigate to signup page
Enter valid email address and strong password
Submit signup form
Check that registration is successful and email verification message is sent

title: Signup with Existing Email
description: Check that signup fails with an error when attempting to register an email already in use.

steps.description: Navigate to signup page
Enter an email already registered and any password
Submit signup form
Verify that an error indicating email in use is shown

title: Email Verification Process
description: Validate that users receive an email verification link and can verify their email successfully.

steps.description: Sign up a new user via email
Check email inbox for verification link
Click verification link
Confirm user email is marked as verified

title: User Login with Email/Password
description: Verify that a verified user can login using their email and password successfully.

steps.description: Navigate to login page
Enter valid, verified email and correct password
Submit login form
Verify login success and redirection to dashboard

title: User Login with Google OAuth
description: Verify that a user can log in using Google OAuth authentication successfully.

steps.description: Navigate to login page
Click on 'Login with Google' button
Complete Google OAuth flow with valid Google account
Verify that user is logged in and redirected to dashboard

title: Password Reset Workflow
description: Test that users can request a password reset and successfully update their password via emailed link.

steps.description: Navigate to forgot password page
Enter registered email and submit reset request
Check email inbox and click password reset link
Enter new valid password and submit
Verify password is updated and user can login with new password

title: Create New Chatbot
description: Verify that a logged-in user can successfully create a new chatbot with valid metadata.

steps.description: Login and navigate to create new bot page
Enter bot name, description, and initial configuration
Submit creation form
Verify new bot is listed in user's bots and details are correct

title: Edit Existing Bot Configuration
description: Check that users can edit and save changes to an existing chatbot's configuration through visual builder.

steps.description: Select an existing bot from bot list
Open the visual bot flow builder
Modify flow components and configuration
Save changes
Verify that changes persist and reflected in bot data

title: Delete a Bot
description: Verify users can delete an existing bot and that it is no longer accessible.

steps.description: Navigate to bot list
Select a bot and initiate delete action
Confirm deletion in prompt
Verify bot is removed from bot list and data store

title: Test Bot Flow with Valid Input
description: Test that a bot responds correctly to valid user inputs during test session in visual builder.

steps.description: Open a bot's test interface
Send valid messages to chatbot
Validate that bot replies match configured flow responses

title: Real-Time Chat Message Sending and Receiving
description: Verify real-time sending and receiving of messages using Socket.IO in chat interface.

steps.description: Open chat interface for a bot
Send message as user
Check message is delivered and displayed instantly to both user and bot
Receive bot reply message
Verify reply appears in real-time without refresh

title: Voice Text-to-Speech Conversion
description: Validate that bot text messages can be converted to speech using supported voices via Google Cloud API.

steps.description: Select bot message to convert to speech
Choose a supported voice
Initiate text-to-speech action
Verify audio plays correctly matching message text

title: Voice Speech-to-Text Input
description: Test bot accepts and correctly transcribes spoken input from user via speech-to-text conversion.

steps.description: Activate speech-to-text input in chat interface
Speak a test phrase clearly
Verify transcribed text matches spoken input and submits to bot

title: Unsupported Voice Feature Fallback Handling
description: Confirm system detects unsupported browser features for voice integration and shows fallback UI.

steps.description: Use a browser environment without Web Speech API support
Navigate to voice integration features
Verify user sees clear message about unsupported feature and no errors occur

title: Image Upload via Cloudinary Integration
description: Verify that image uploads succeed and are stored in Cloudinary in production environment.

steps.description: Navigate to bot or chat image upload interface
Select valid image file and upload
Verify upload completes successfully and image is accessible from Cloudinary URL

title: File Upload Fallback to Local Storage
description: Validate that file uploads fall back to local storage when Cloudinary is unavailable (e.g., in development mode).

steps.description: Configure environment for local storage fallback
Upload an image or file
Confirm file is stored locally and accessible

title: Analytics Dashboard Accuracy
description: Verify analytics dashboard shows accurate, current metrics on bot usage and user engagements.

steps.description: Generate bot usage data by interacting with bot
Navigate to analytics dashboard for the bot
Review accuracy and timeliness of displayed metrics and charts

title: Embed Chat Widget on External Website
description: Test that chat widget embed script can be added to an external site and functions correctly with customization options.

steps.description: Copy embed script from bot embed page
Insert script with customization options into sample external web page
Load external page and verify chat widget appears and operates correctly

title: Team Member Invitation and Role Assignment
description: Verify user can invite team members and assign roles successfully, and the invitee receives notification.

steps.description: Navigate to team management section
Send invitation to new collaborator email and assign role
Verify invite is recorded and invitee receives email invitation

title: Team Member Access Control
description: Check that team members with different roles have appropriate permissions and restricted access.

steps.description: Login as team member with limited role
Attempt to perform actions restricted to admins (e.g., delete bot)
Verify access is denied and error or warning message shown

title: Webhook Integration Trigger and Security
description: Validate that configured webhooks trigger correctly with proper authentication and handle failures securely.

steps.description: Configure webhook URL and authentication for a bot
Trigger event that calls webhook
Confirm webhook receives expected payload and verifies authentication
Trigger webhook with invalid token or authentication
Verify webhook rejects unauthorized requests gracefully

title: UI Component Rendering Consistency
description: Verify that reusable UI components render correctly and consistently across supported browsers and device screen sizes.

steps.description: Load pages with Radix UI components on multiple browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge)
Check correct styling, layout, and functionality
Resize browser window and test on mobile device simulators
Verify responsiveness and accessibility compliance

title: Handling Invalid Bot Configuration in Builder
description: Test that invalid configurations in the bot visual builder are detected and appropriate validation messages are shown.

steps.description: Create or edit a bot flow with missing required nodes or invalid transitions
Attempt to save the bot configuration
Verify validation errors are displayed and save is prevented until fixed

title: Chat Message Persistence After Refresh
description: Verify that messages in a conversation persist and are correctly reloaded from the server on page refresh.

steps.description: Open an active conversation and send messages
Refresh the chat page
Verify that all previous messages are loaded and displayed correctly

title: File Upload Limits and Error Handling
description: Test uploading unsupported file types, oversized files, and simulate network failure during upload to validate error handling.

steps.description: Attempt file upload with unsupported file type (e.g., .exe)
Verify error message indicates unsupported file type
Attempt file upload with file exceeding size limits
Verify appropriate error about file size is shown
Simulate network failure during upload
Check that error is caught and user informed to retry
